description.value: Mega Sushi is an award-winning Japanese restaurant located near Steveston Harbour in Richmond, voted best sushi restaurant by Richmond Review readers and top-rated on TripAdvisor. Part of the Mega Group's 14-location BC chain, this independently run outpost is known for using fresh local ingredients and a distinctive roasted-salt technique that enhances the flavour of its fish. Cyclists exploring the Steveston waterfront will find it a short ride from the pier, with a full dine-in menu as well as Korean dishes and desserts.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active dine-in and takeout sushi restaurant at 3131 Chatham St, Richmond, near Steveston Harbour — a popular cycling destination. Takeout is explicitly confirmed via 'TOGO MENU', online pickup ordering, and SkipTheDishes integration. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site, so those remain null per the absence-of-evidence rule.
